boundary_note: Every tabulated state is single-phase. A grid cell is left blank only where the state at that pressure and temperature would be two-phase or liquid - at or above the saturation pressure at that temperature - and the explorer will not interpolate across such a cell. Because the critical temperature of nitrogen is -146.96 degC, below the -20 degC floor of this grid, every (pressure, temperature) point tabulated here is a supercritical single-phase fluid, so no cell is blank.
